en: The postcard features an illustrated bouquet of lilacs in purple and white, with some green leaves. The background is a soft, aged cream color. The top right area contains stylized handwritten German text including 'Fröhliche Ostern' (Happy Easter). Additional handwritten text is present, and at the bottom center, the name 'Eduard Jansen, Dorpat' is printed, indicating the publisher or printer.
